name: trailogue
description: Trailogue overseas iOS app and TypeScript backend monorepo

scripts.install:api: npm --prefix packages/domain ci --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/domain && npm --prefix packages/domain run build && npm --prefix packages/contracts ci --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/contracts && npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && npm --prefix packages/config ci --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/config && npm --prefix packages/config run build && npm --prefix packages/database ci --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/database && npm --prefix packages/database run build && npm --prefix apps/api ci --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/api
scripts.install:all: npm run install:api && npm --prefix apps/worker install --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/worker && npm --prefix ios-app install --install-links --no-audit --no-fund --cache .npm-cache/ios
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/api run dev
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/worker run dev
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/domain run build && npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && npm --prefix packages/config run build && npm --prefix packages/database run build
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/worker run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/domain run lint && npm --prefix packages/contracts run lint && npm --prefix packages/config run lint && npm --prefix packages/database run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/worker run lint && npm --prefix ios-app run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/domain run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/config run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/database run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/worker run typecheck && npm --prefix ios-app run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix packages/config test && npm --prefix packages/database test && npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/worker test && npm --prefix ios-app test -- --ci
